# ship-permissions

Your interface to the `permissions` ops. Invoke each over ConnectRPC:

```
ship ops call <name> --json '<args-json>'
```

Reads are safe (C0). Commands carry a blast-radius class. Open an op's reference
page for full args, return shape, capability, and an example.

## Reads

- [`permissions.get`](references/docs/permissions.get.mdoc) — Permission preset at the requested scope — id, scope, and JSON body.
- [`permissions.list`](references/docs/permissions.list.mdoc) — List permission presets across scopes.
- [`permissions.tool_patterns`](references/docs/permissions.tool_patterns.mdoc) — Enumerate tool-pattern capability names (for agent builders).

## Commands

- [`permissions.create`](references/docs/permissions.create.mdoc) `[C2_ELEVATED]` — Create a new permission preset (errors if the id is taken).
- [`permissions.delete`](references/docs/permissions.delete.mdoc) `[C2_ELEVATED]` — Remove a permission preset (scope omitted walks project → user).
- [`permissions.patch`](references/docs/permissions.patch.mdoc) `[C2_ELEVATED]` — Apply RFC-6902 ops to a permission preset's body.
- [`permissions.put`](references/docs/permissions.put.mdoc) `[C2_ELEVATED]` — Replace a permission preset's body (use permissions.create for net-new).
